sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 560. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Miracle.
-Target: all allies. Status ailment resistance value boosted by 60 for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases critical hit chance by 50% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Boosts critical hit Ability Power by 100 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases Critical Assault (increases Ability Power when performing critical hits) buff limit by 50 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Changes Cost held to 50. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies Serenity for 90 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
-Target: yourself. Applies Ambush for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; reduces the cooldown time of Abilities to 0 (except for certain Abilities); nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000

[Watermelon Splitting?] Sylpha or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
